verdict.rationale: Ardent is a database-branching SaaS that handles customer data, so an AI-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions model training, training opt-outs or data-use policy. The architecture claim that data stays in the data plane is a related data-residency control, not a commitment about training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
